QuestionText: Which part of the computer is known as its 'Brain'?
Explanation: The CPU (Central Processing Unit) processes all the instructions, just like our brain does.

QuestionText: What do we use to type letters and numbers on a computer?
Explanation: The keyboard has many keys that help us type text into the computer.

QuestionText: Which part shows us the work we are doing on the computer?
Explanation: The monitor is the display screen where we see pictures, movies, and text.

QuestionText: A computer mouse usually has ________ buttons.
Explanation: A standard computer mouse has a Left button and a Right button.

QuestionText: Which part of the computer helps us to point at and select items on the screen?
Explanation: The mouse moves the pointer (arrow) on the screen to help us click on things.

QuestionText: What does CPU stand for?
Explanation: CPU stands for Central Processing Unit.

QuestionText: Which device is used to print our work onto a sheet of paper?
Explanation: A printer takes information from the computer and puts it on paper.

QuestionText: We use __________ to hear music and sounds from the computer.
Explanation: Speakers or headphones are used to listen to audio from the computer.

QuestionText: Which part of the computer keeps it running for some time even when the power goes out?
Explanation: UPS (Uninterruptible Power Supply) provides battery backup when electricity is cut off.

QuestionText: The longest key on the keyboard is the __________.
Explanation: The Spacebar is the widest/longest key at the bottom of the keyboard.

QuestionText: Which key is used to start a new line while typing?
Explanation: The Enter key moves the cursor to the beginning of the next line.

QuestionText: Which of these is NOT one of the main four parts of a computer?
Explanation: Monitor, CPU, Keyboard, and Mouse are the four main parts; headphones are extra.

QuestionText: Where do we find the Alphabet keys?
Explanation: Alphabet keys (A-Z) are located on the keyboard.

QuestionText: The small arrow seen on the monitor is called the __________.
Explanation: The arrow that moves when you move the mouse is the pointer.

QuestionText: Which part should be handled carefully and kept on a flat pad?
Explanation: A mouse works best when moved on a smooth, flat surface called a mouse pad.

QuestionText: Which key helps us erase a mistake while typing?
Explanation: The Backspace key erases characters to the left of the cursor.

QuestionText: A Laptop has a __________ instead of a separate mouse.
Explanation: Laptops have a built-in touch-sensitive area called a touchpad.

QuestionText: What do we call the buttons on a keyboard?
Explanation: The buttons we press to type are called keys.

QuestionText: To hear sound privately without disturbing others, we use __________.
Explanation: Headphones are worn over the ears so only you can hear the sound.

QuestionText: How many Alphabet keys are there on a standard keyboard?
Explanation: There are 26 letters in the English alphabet, so there are 26 alphabet keys.

QuestionText: Which part of the computer looks like a big box?
Explanation: The CPU is housed inside a rectangular cabinet or tower.

QuestionText: The wheel between the two mouse buttons is used for ___________.
Explanation: The scroll wheel helps us move a page up or down on the screen.

QuestionText: Which key is used to give space between words?
Explanation: We press the Spacebar once to leave a blank space between two words.

QuestionText: A desktop computer cannot work without a __________.
Explanation: The CPU is essential for the computer to function.

QuestionText: The buttons on the top row of the keyboard with numbers 0-9 are ________.
Explanation: Keys used for typing numbers are called Number keys.

QuestionText: Which part allows you to see your friends during a video call?
Explanation: A webcam is a camera that captures video for the computer.

QuestionText: Clicking the left mouse button twice quickly is called __________.
Explanation: Double-clicking is used to open files or programs.

QuestionText: We use a __________ to put our pictures into the computer.
Explanation: A scanner reads a paper document/photo and saves it as a file on the computer.

QuestionText: Which key is used to type capital letters only?
Explanation: When Caps Lock is ON, all letters typed will be in CAPITAL form.

QuestionText: A printer gives us a __________ copy of our work.
Explanation: A printout on paper is called a 'Hard Copy'.

QuestionText: Which part has a 'Start' button to turn the computer on?
Explanation: The power button is usually found on the CPU cabinet.

QuestionText: The blinking line on the monitor that shows where you will type is the __________.
Explanation: The cursor is the small blinking vertical line on the screen.

QuestionText: Which of these is a small, portable storage device?
Explanation: A pen drive is used to carry files from one computer to another.

QuestionText: Arrow keys are used to move the cursor in __________ directions.
Explanation: There are four arrow keys: Up, Down, Left, and Right.

QuestionText: You should not press the keys of the keyboard __________.
Explanation: Pressing keys too hard can damage the keyboard.

QuestionText: A mouse is connected to the _________.
Explanation: The mouse cable is plugged into the CPU cabinet.

QuestionText: Which device helps us to record our voice into the computer?
Explanation: A microphone (Mic) is used to input sound/voice into the computer.

QuestionText: The screen of the monitor should be cleaned with a __________ cloth.
Explanation: Always use a soft, lint-free dry cloth to clean the monitor screen.

QuestionText: Which part acts as a link between the user and the computer?
Explanation: We use the keyboard and mouse to give commands to the computer.

QuestionText: How many Enter keys are usually on a keyboard?
Explanation: Most standard keyboards have two Enter keys for convenience.

QuestionText: The full form of UPS is __________.
Explanation: UPS stands for Uninterruptible Power Supply.

QuestionText: A computer mouse is kept on a __________.
Explanation: A mouse pad provides the best surface for the mouse sensor to work.

QuestionText: Which of these is used for playing games more easily?
Explanation: A joystick is often used to control movements in video games.

QuestionText: The CPU is always kept __________.
Explanation: The actual CPU chip is inside the CPU box/cabinet.

QuestionText: Monitor is also called __________.
Explanation: VDU stands for Visual Display Unit.

QuestionText: Which part helps us to draw a circle on the computer?
Explanation: We use the mouse to draw and paint on the screen.

QuestionText: Numeric keypad is found on the __________ side of the keyboard.
Explanation: On a full-sized keyboard, the number pad is on the far right.

QuestionText: What happens if we pull the wires of a computer?
Explanation: Pulling wires can break connections and stop the computer from working.

QuestionText: Which key is used to remove characters to the right of the cursor?
Explanation: Backspace erases to the left; Delete erases to the right.

QuestionText: A computer is an __________ machine.
Explanation: A computer is an electronic machine because it uses complex circuits.
